examples.text: Das Entstehen von Gasansammlungen im Magen-Darm-Trakt wird begünstigt durch: (...) Verschlucken von Luft, zum Beispiel durch hastiges Essen, schnelles Verschlingen von Nahrung oder beim Rauchen.
examples.translation: La formation d'accumulations de gaz dans le tractus gastro-intestinal est favorisée par : (...) avalage d'air, par exemple en mangeant trop vite, en engloutissant rapidement les aliments ou en fumant.

examples.text: Besonders gern erzählte sie Geschichten über Hochzeitsnächte, die alle ein schlechtes Ende zu nehmen pflegten: in einer Geschichte war der Ehemann so hastig und brutal, daß sich seine Frau am Bettpfosten das Genick brach, (...)
examples.translation: Elle se plaisait à raconter des histoires de nuits de noces qui finissaient toujours mal: tantôt le mari, dans sa hâte brutale, rompait le cou de sa femme contre le bois du lit

examples.text: Tobi packte mich und warf mich aufs Bett (...) Er fummelte gerade hastig an meinem BH herum, als die Tür aufging und ich Schritte im Zimmer hörte.
examples.translation: Tobi m'a attrapée et m'a jetée sur le lit (...) Il était en train de hâtivement tripoter mon soutien-gorge quand la porte s'est ouverte et j'ai entendu des pas dans la chambre.

examples.text:
Humboldt lud hastig das Gewehr.
Keine gute Idee, sagte Carlos. Der Urwald sei nirgendwo dichter, die Luft zu feucht für Waffen.
examples.translation:
Humboldt chargea son fusil en hâte.
Ce n’était pas une bonne idée, dit Carlos. La forêt vierge n’était nulle part plus épaisse qu’ici, l’air trop humide pour les armes.

glosses: zu schnell und ohne Sorgfalt, genaue Überlegung oder große Vorbereitung; in großer Eile

examples.text: Der Dieb nahm hastig ein paar herumliegende Wertsachen und floh als er die Sirenen der Polizei hörte.
Hastig steckt der Mann eine Dokumentenmappe in seine Aktentasche.
Tatsächlich ist die Teilnahme des Syrers an einem hastig einberufenen Mini-Gipfel der libanesischen Regierung mit dem saudischen König eine kleine Sensation.

translations.source_sense_description: zu schnell und ohne Sorgfalt, genaue Überlegung oder große Vorbereitung; in großer Eile

glosses: Acting or done in haste; hurried or too quick; speedy due to having little time.

examples.text: Without much thinking about it they made a hasty decision to buy it.

If there bee any lasie fellow, any that cannot away with worke, any that would wallow in pleasures, hee is hastie to be priested. And when hee is made one, and has gotten a benefice, he consorts with his neighbour priests, who are altogether given to pleasures; and then both hee, and they, live, not like Christians, but like epicures; drinking, eating, feasting, and revelling, till the cow come home, as the saying is.

I have written these hasty lines in no small hurry, and send them to you, not from an opinion, that they contain any thing worth imparting, but merely in compliance with your and Mr Simon's request[…]
Watch yourself, be the first to ask pardon if you both err, and guard against the little piques, misunderstandings, and hasty words that often pave the way for bitter sorrow and regret.
But about three o'clock George's ear caught the hasty and decided click of a horse's hoof coming behind them at some distance and jogged Phineas by the elbow.

glosses: Acting or done in haste; hurried or too quick; speedy due to having little time.

examples.text: Sommer Hony, or hasty hony, made in thirty dales after the tenth of June.
[We] built a hasty fort of sawlogs and boulders back of our campsite, well stocked with powder and ball, water and meat, in case there was trouble.

glosses: Acting or done in haste; hurried or too quick; speedy due to having little time.
Ripening or coming to maturity early.

examples.text: ... how to make the trees themselves more tall, more spread, and more hasty and sudden than they use to be.
I speke not of hasty pees, for they be sowen before Christmasse

glosses: Acting or done in haste; hurried or too quick; speedy due to having little time.
Eager or impatient to act or get something done.

examples.text: ... how is it that ye be so hasty to […] departe hens?
... the Queene is not so hasty of your death.

glosses: Acting or done in haste; hurried or too quick; speedy due to having little time.
Characterized by undue quickness of action, and thus lacking careful thought or consideration; rash, precipitate.

examples.text: a hasty decision, a hasty assertion
... to give too hasty belief to pretended miracles,[…]

glosses: Speedy, quick, rapid (without necessarily lacking time).

examples.text: This people hathe a swyfte hasty speche.
Thys wolfbayne of all poysones is the most hastye poison.

glosses: Irritable, irascible; quickly or easily excited to anger.

examples.text: his hasty temperament
The natural disposition of Theodosius was hasty and choleric;[…]
... I spake eny hasty worde […]

To say that such a one has rather a hasty temper, or that he is difficult to get on with, or that he is too fond of having his own way, is hardly, in the opinion of many people, to say anything really to his discredit;[…]

Hasty rain liberates flukes' eggs from sheep's droppings, and splashes them round about upon the circumjacent herbage; but healthy sheep, protected by their nose, are in little danger here of swallowing these eggs […]
... hasty rain. When we came home we found Cousin Gwinn Harris and wife at our home. In the evening there was still another rain. These rains are all alike (hard and hasty).[…]
'[…] rain divert me, although it is coming down hasty.'

glosses: Qui devance le temps, en parlant de ce qui est susceptible d’accroissement.

examples.text: Croissance hâtive.
Esprit hâtif.
La puberté est toujours plus hâtive chez les peuples policés.
Fruit hâtif.
On avait signalé de hâtifs passages de hérons au-dessus des bois de Meudon.
Terrain hâtif.
Il y a des arbres hâtifs dans le jardin de notre époux.
Un printemps doux et, par conséquent, une année hâtive, toujours favorable à la vigne et à la qualité de son fruit.

glosses: Qui se développent plus tôt que l’espèce, en parlant de variétés de plantes, de fruits ou de fleurs.

examples.text: Heureusement tous les cossons n'étaient pas partis. Il y a des cépages peu hâtifs qui prudemment n’ont pas « débourré » — et, chose remarquable, ce ne sont pas ceux dits « du pays » qu'on s'obstine, aveuglément, à recommander.
Les fouets hâtifs sont déployés.
